technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with some structural bullish signals (supertrend, Ichimoku) are offset by bearish momentum crossovers, negative volume flow, and price below key moving averages—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, retail interest minimal, and earnings in 58 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no conviction signal; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (311.68) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 58 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI(9), supertrend bullish signal, and price at support (128.39) with contrarian fear-zone opportunity create potential mean-reversion setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish momentum structure (EMA death cross, MACD bearish, CMF negative, OBV flat), price below both EMA(9) and EMA(21), macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 311.68, strong USD), and upcoming earnings in 58 days create compounding headwinds that overshadow oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI(9) and supertrend bullish signal present mean-reversion opportunity at support; however, bearish momentum structure (EMA death cross, MACD bearish, CMF negative) and macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 311.68) create insufficient confluence for conviction entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 58 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creates execution risk that overshadows technical oversold conditions; macro headwinds likely to persist through earnings.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear dominance despite technical oversold signals
decision.portfolio_note: Existing AMZN position and 3 open Consumer Discretionary positions reduce conviction further; portfolio concentration in sector already elevated.
